Definition: Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase)
BiblicalUsage: Ashtoreth = "star"; 1) the principal female deity of the Phoenicians worshipped in war and fertility; 1a) also 'Ishtar' of Assyria and 'Astarte' by the Greeks and Romans
